args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 release
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy (error rate was 0.18; v2.3.1 was running in us-east, us-west, and eu-west). Per the runbook, I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, in all production regions. The rollback reports v2.3.0 running in us-east, us-west, and eu-west, with execution state VERIFIED. v2.3.1 is marked unhealthy in production. Next steps: confirm error rate and health checks have recovered, and investigate the v2.3.1 failure before any re-release.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged the on-call engineer.

- **Rollback:** v2.3.1 was running in all regions and marked unhealthy, with an error rate of 0.18. v2.3.0 was the most recent release that had been healthy in production. The rollback reports v2.3.0 now running in every region, with execution state VERIFIED.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 describes the failed health checks after the v2.3.1 release, the rollback to v2.3.0, and the next steps.

I haven't re-checked the service status since the rollback, so recovery of health checks and error rate is still unconfirmed. Investigating v2.3.1 is also still open, and it should be resolved before that version is released again.

content.text: The most recent production release that was healthy is v2.3.0. v2.3.1 is the unhealthy one, and it is what all three regions are currently running. I'll roll back to v2.3.0.
